new_en_text: Can those not from the Academy of Mechanics sign up? We want to help too.

zh_text: 当然可以！大家一起群策群力！

new_en_text: What's wrong with the academy? I haven't seen the Dean and the others...

zh_text: 学纪狗，打起精神来，需要的话我们也去帮忙。

new_en_text: With such a major incident, why haven't we seen the Dean?

zh_text: 我想夫子一定是在处理更棘手的事情。
new_en_text: I think the Master must be dealing with something more pressing.

zh_text: 通天塔的外环碎了！等等，这种情况该怎么办……
new_en_text: The outer ring of the Tower of Heaven is broken! Wait, what should we do in this situation...

new_en_text: Senior, will we be unable to attend classes from now on?

zh_text: 怎么偏偏这个时候……夫子也不知道去哪儿了，学院都要乱套了……
new_en_text: Why now of all times... I don't know where the Master went either, the academy is going to be in chaos...

zh_text: 请同学们保持秩序，我们会确保大家的安全！
new_en_text: Students, please maintain order. We will ensure everyone's safety!

zh_text: 有事找我？请问是什么委托？
